title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Cost visibility in Preview Chat and History
description: Now makers will have clear visibility into their consumption costs directly within preview tab and agent history for their preview/testing usage as well as all every historical run. Makers can see the costs as they test, iterate, and review conversations, making usage costs transparent throughout the development experience.
